testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a recent part's file properties after an informational notice: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:276:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a recent part's file properties after an informational notice ✔ Given a fresh MCAD Software process starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native/Part23.opd` is displayed in List View ✔ And no Recent-file properties action has been requested in this process ✔ And the user chooses the part's document properties action and an informational notice is displayed ✔ When the user dismisses the informational notice ✔ Then a file properties window for the part is displayed ✔ And its General page shows the file name, type, location, sizes, dates and attributes ✔ When the user dismisses the properties window ✔ Then the Recent list is visible again
